concept.title: Doodh Ki Shart
concept.big_idea: A short bargaining sketch in the child's own style: she sets a 'condition' for milk, the adult produces the Little Joys Nutrimix as a prop, and an adult voiceover (not the child) reads one label line. She ends on a playful 'verdict tomorrow'.
concept.archetype: Child-performer bargaining sketch with adult co-star
concept.objective: Attention-stage creative test with this creator. A hypothesis, not a prediction: organic results do not predict paid performance.
why_fit: Creative DNA: Across 20 posts: formats piece to camera (60%), skit (15%); content lifestyle (50%), comedy skit (35%); language hindi (65%), english (20%); settings indoor home (75%), outdoor (25%); children on camera 100%; product shown 20%; sponsored 5%.

Child visible on screen (100% of posts): Build the brief around the creator's own child in the product's routine moment (breakfast, tiffin, milk time). Caution: Ads: the strongest signal is a child in the FIRST 3 s, which posts cannot show (no timing label).

Humour (75% of posts): Light situational humour is natural for this creator; use it to earn attention, and keep the offer/product step unambiguous for conversion. Caution: Ads: humour raises 3-s hook rate but 'no humour' has HIGHER click→purchase (stable candidate). Humour in ads is rare (15 of 97).
Attention alignment score 57/100 (AI-labelled posts vs paid-ad hook-rate patterns; organic engagement is not treated as evidence of paid performance).

tone.summary: High-energy, playful child performance with an adult straight-man; product facts come only from an adult voiceover.
delivery: Pace: quick and bouncy for the child, slow and clear for the adult label line.
Short, scripted-by-adults lines in her own comedic-timing style; exaggerated expressions.
Product is a prop in an everyday home situation, not a testimonial.
tone.camera: Home set, child to camera with adult co-star
tone.creator_voice_in_profile: The creator speaks with the high-pitched, energetic, and expressive tone of a young child, often delivering lines scripted by adults in Hindi.
tone.catchphrases_in_profile: direct address to the camera; exaggerated facial expressions; traditional Indian festive attire; comedic timing with adult co-stars
tone.native_in_profile: A short, high-energy skit where Shivanya uses a product as a prop in a relatable, everyday situation like getting ready for school or playing at home.

avoid.item: Any claim that the product treats, prevents or cures anything, or improves immunity, growth, height, weight, brain development or strength.
avoid.reason: No such claim is verified in the supplied files; several older ads contain them (see restricted claims list).

avoid.item: Any number, percentage, multiplier or vitamin count that is not one of the verified product facts for the chosen product.
avoid.reason: Numeric claims must trace to a fact ID.

avoid.item: Superlatives and exclusivity ("best", "only", "No. 1", "bestseller", "loved by 10 lakh moms").
avoid.reason: Appear in older ad copy but cannot be substantiated from the files.

avoid.item: Comparisons with, or mentions of, other brands or products.
avoid.reason: Competitor kids-nutrition brands appear in several shortlisted creators' sponsored posts; keep the Little Joys video clean of them.

avoid.item: Third-party testing or certification claims (e.g. lab tested, Eurofins).
avoid.reason: Mentioned in ad copy, but certificates are not part of the supplied files.

avoid.item: Scripted taste or eating outcomes ("kids love it", "finishes it in two minutes"). Film real reactions only.
avoid.reason: Outcome claims are unverified; scripted reactions would misrepresent what happened.

avoid.item: "Doctor recommended", "expert approved" or any medical-authority endorsement the creator has not personally confirmed.
avoid.reason: Endorsement must be genuine and disclosed.

avoid.item: Age suitability, serving size or dosage statements unless supplied by Little Joys.
avoid.reason: Not available in the supplied files; left as [[CONFIRM: ...]] placeholders.
Every script ends with a disclosure line; confirm the platform's disclosure label.

avoid.item: A polished testimonial in which the child reads product benefits or specifications (her profile flags this as foreign, and it is a child-advertising risk).
avoid.reason: Creator-specific (from her/his own profile and posts).

avoid.item: Having the child make any claim, comparison or taste verdict about the product; keep the verdict a joke.
avoid.reason: Creator-specific (from her/his own profile and posts).

avoid.item: Competitor brands: her sponsored posts have shown other kids-nutrition brands.
avoid.reason: Creator-specific (from her/his own profile and posts).

avoid.item: Filming or publishing without the guardians' confirmation of consent and disclosure.
avoid.reason: Creator-specific (from her/his own profile and posts).

avoid.item: Other brands visible in this creator's posts (AI-labelled): Disney, Frozen, Gritzo, HP, Hollyland, Keekee, booba_babydoll. Do not show or mention any in the Little Joys video.
avoid.reason: Exclusivity and clean-brand framing; verify contracts.

avoid.item: Foreign-feeling styles per profile: A polished, corporate-style testimonial where the child reads a script about product benefits or technical specifications.
